title: IPA package store manifest (v1)
description: Ordered registry of uploadable IPA builds for one app. The store lives on the host under packages/<app>/; slot prefixes give a stable order for switching which build is installed into the VM.

default_slot.description: Default slot selected when a caller omits an explicit Build. It does not describe device state.

release_like.description: IPA 应用包内存在离线 JavaScript bundle；旧条目可省略，完整性校验后安全回填

release_evidence.description: release_like 的包内结构证据；旧条目可省略，完整性校验后安全回填

short_version.description: CFBundleShortVersionString; null means it was not recorded.

build_version.description: CFBundleVersion; null means it was not recorded.
